product_controls.route_scope_resolution: POST resolves the active student membership from authenticated user plus x-contract-id before invoking the completion service.
product_controls.resource_scope_binding: completeByStudent requires alunoId and contractId and rejects a review whose owning aluno/contract differs.
product_controls.transactional_authority: Each completion transaction revalidates ACTIVE_STUDENT for user+aluno+contract and conditionally updates only the pending review.
product_controls.concurrent_retry: A conditional pending update maps P2025 to a safe not-pending error, preventing duplicate completion from becoming success.

limitations: Full local skill ecosystem exceeded the local execution window after multiple passing modules; fast ecosystem and focused systemic tests are complete. Product validation relies on canonical remote CI for the exact material head.
